messages:
elaine (partner-eng): Quick sync — I'm starting a tiny e2e smoke harness for marketplace Terraform modules that exercise LLM-serving patterns (simple chat + embeddings + latency check). Goal is a fast CI job partners can run before we accept marketplace artifacts. Thoughts?
raj (cloud-eng): Love it. Can we keep it <5m per run and make it cloud-agnostic? AWS/GCP/Azure + one arm64 hw run.
elaine (partner-eng): Yes, target <5m. We'll do a quick matrix: provider, arch (x86/arm), and model-size bucket (tiny/medium). Minimal resource footprint.
sophie (qa): I'll author the test cases. Suggest 3 checks: 1) terraform apply + smoke deploy 2) basic request to /v1/chat -> check latency & status 3) verify logs + telemetry export.
tom-infra: For the TF part, keep versions pinned and use a local state backend (s3/gs file emulation) to avoid infra churn. Also include a destroy step.
elaine (partner-eng): Putting a sample checklist here: - ./tests/run-smoke.sh - provider env var (AWS/GCP/AZURE) - TF version constraint - model endpoint mock or small open model - metrics push to ephemeral prometheus
raj (cloud-eng): Can we surface a tiny terraform snippet partners can copy? e.g.:
```hcl
terraform { required_version = ">= 1.4" }
provider "aws" { region = var.region }
module "redwood_marketplace_ref" { source = "./modules/llm-serving" }
```
elaine (partner-eng): Nice. Also include a tiny config for running the runtime in dev mode (1 replica, low mem) and a healthcheck: `/health` and `/v1/ping`.
sophie (qa): For validation, I'll use a golden prompt set (3 prompts) and assert token count & substring of response. If regression, fail the job. Keep thresholds loose.
tom-infra: Add a quick lint step for Terraform fmt + tflint. Command: `make tf-check` as part of CI.
elaine (partner-eng): Thinking about naming: `mini-e2e-harness` in repo root + `examples/marketplace-quickstart`. We'll add a badge partners can paste.
raj (cloud-eng): For cloud-specific infra (marketplace packaging), include a smoke test that exercises the packaging artifact (e.g., AMI/container + marketplace metadata). Keep it optional via `--run-packaging`.
sophie (qa): I'll wire up GH Actions job template that forks these steps. Will stub secrets with `ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN` for now.
elaine (partner-eng): Nice. Tom, can you add a tiny Prometheus job in `dev` that scrapes `/metrics` for latency histogram? We can fail if p95 > 500ms for tiny model.
tom-infra: Yep. I'll add a prometheus.yml snippet and a Grafana dashboard JSON in `monitoring/`.
elaine (partner-eng): Proposed next steps: 1) Sophie drafts tests + GH workflow 2) Raj writes provider-agnostic TF wrapper + snippet 3) Tom adds monitoring bits 4) I’ll draft partner-facing README and badge. Aim to have PRs by EOW.
raj (cloud-eng): I'll take provider wrapper.
sophie (qa): Taking tests + workflows.
tom-infra: On monitoring.
elaine (partner-eng): Cool. If anyone has small example partner repos we should run this against, drop links here. Also ping @deploy-bot when PRs are ready so we can gate a quick smoke run. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Reminder set for Thursday 15:00 UTC to run the first harness against `partner/samples/llm-quickstart`.
elaine (partner-eng): Sweet — thanks all. Keeping this low friction is critical for partner adoption.
